source.note: Assumption, unverified for the bands and the usual ranges; the schema has one evidence field per template, so slotEvidence and usual.evidence stay assumption although the nominal ratio was read. Read: classic 2 oz bourbon, 1 sugar cube, 2 dashes bitters; root recipe 2 oz spirit, 1 tsp syrup, 2 + 1 dashes bitters. The nominal spec (60 ml, 4.2 g sugar, 1.8 ml bitters) is the classic recipe; the root's teaspoon of syrup (0.17 parts) and 3 dashes (0.09 parts) lie inside the bands. Slots after the bitters are chosen here: the book files the Sazerac and the Mint Julep under this template, but no ratio for them was read. See docs/templates.md#evidence.
